items.text: Ba Llb, BBA Llb BA LLB, BBA LLB or BCom LLB (5-year integrated, after Class 12).

items.heading: The Order Is Deliberate
items.text: The order is deliberate. Routes where you can set your own price and grow by adding clients, people or packages come first. Routes that run on a fixed ladder or on beating rivals at stage after stage come later, and stay in the list with their risk named.

rows: LLB finished, AIBE not yet cleared
A degree and provisional enrolment. You can learn in a chamber or firm, but you cannot yet file or argue on your own.
AIBE XXII is scheduled for 29 November 2026 (tentative). Clearing it gives the Certificate of Practice.
Do not leave this to the last month. Every court route, and the judiciary clock, starts after enrolment.
The licence to practise in court as an advocate.
No further licence. The next step are a chamber seat, a firm interview, a state judicial notification or a client.
This is where route choice starts to matter, because a full-time salaried job can end your right to appear in court (see the Bar Council section).
